title: Workspace not creating desktop shortcut or launching

proposed_fixes.title: Keep Workspaces persistence and shortcut creation consistent
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The workspace may not be persisted before shortcut creation, or the shortcut may use a different path; the report does not distinguish these cases.
plan: Trace editor save through WorkspaceStore and desktop shortcut creation.
Use the successfully persisted project path for shortcut creation and surface save failures instead of leaving a dangling shortcut.
Test failed save and shortcut target resolution.

Verify the project JSON exists at the target and the shortcut launches all configured apps.

comment.body:
Thanks for documenting the capture/save sequence and checking the shortcut target; the report already says the target JSON was missing. Could you check these two points?
1. Repeat once with a new workspace name and confirm whether that JSON exists anywhere and whether shortcut Properties matches the path shown by Workspaces. Share only the file name/relative location, not personal paths.
2. If it fails again, add `/bugreport` immediately after the failed save/launch and attach the package. If Settings and the tray are unavailable, run `BugReportTool.exe` from the PowerToys installation directory.
This distinguishes a failed project write from a dangling shortcut target.
